question: Which accessibility/privacy/safeguarding external standards must be binding Code Guide requirements?
why_existing_authority_is_insufficient: CGP-003 may identify existing references but cannot adopt or update external standards.
options: Keep references supporting only; adopt specific standards later; defer until guide drafting.
recommendation: Defer until guide-specific drafting with Founder/legal/product authority.
decision: Existing references to external standards, frameworks, platforms, and providers remain SUPPORTING unless and until a specific standard and version are separately adopted through authorized guide-drafting, legal, product, privacy, security, safeguarding, or Founder disposition. Repository reference alone does not make an external standard binding.
required_later_action: Guide-specific drafting may propose standard adoption, but may not silently elevate a referenced standard into controlling authority.
disposition_notes: Founder disposition recorded during CGP-003 pre-merge reconciliation; original decision request retained for history.

question: How should current application behavior be treated when it conflicts with adopted documentary authority?

options: Treat code as defect; treat source as stale; request Founder decision; defer implementation mapping.

question: What is the exact precedence rule among global governance lock, artifact-specific lock records, PIA receipts, and implementation atlas material?

question: When, if ever, may Code Guides become merge/release/production controls?
why_existing_authority_is_insufficient: CGP-003 and prior prompts preserve all guides as planned/not adopted/not active.
options: Never; advisory only; merge gate after adoption; release gate after assurance.
recommendation: Defer to later adoption/activation prompt; keep all activation false now.
decision: Code Guide adoption alone does not activate implementation, PR, merge, release, deployment, pilot, or production gates. Any active engineering gate requires a separate activation disposition after guide approval, accession, validation, reviews, mappings, ownership, enforcement behavior, rollback/disablement treatment, and authority confirmation.
required_later_action: Keep every Code Guide documentary and advisory until a separate activation disposition authorizes a specific control or guide gate.
